answer: A hollow identity is cheap to fake, so tie each agent voting weight to a verifiable stake of real work: a beacon of recent attested transactions that peers can re-check on-ledger. Creating a fresh identity then costs as much as rebuilding that whole history, like felling and hauling timber one log at a time, while one honest agent earns weight from a single continuous record. Sybils stay cheap to create but worthless to use.
